O6_metrics.path_mean: '32 路径均值' = arithmetic mean over the 32 paths of the per-path metric; '[2.5%, 97.5%] 路径分位' = numpy linear percentiles of the 32 per-path values. G3 uses the path-mean of per-path Sharpe and of per-path maxDD. The certified MEAN-PATH values (bt_tables series_mean) are reported beside, descriptive only.
O6_metrics.sharpe: mean(r_d)/std(r_d, ddof=1)*sqrt(365) on full UTC days
O6_metrics.total_return: prod over the segment's windows of (1 + r_w) - 1
O6_metrics.maxdd_5m: bt_tables.maxdd_5m on the path's own 5-minute main NAV over the segment's windows (segment start NAV = first point)
O6_metrics.cash_decomposition: bt_tables series_from_path units, bps per anchor per unit target gross (gm = 2.0): price(+trading) / funding paid / fee / unknown-excluded, identity g = price - funding - fee - unknown asserted <= 1e-9 per window; turnover over gross; each as the path mean of the per-path segment mean
O6_metrics.events: section 4-2 day-stop flattens = sum over the segment of n_flatten_events; per-name stops = sum of n_stop_events; path mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles

O7_pairing: d_k(t) = r_NEW,k(t) - r_OLD,k(t) on full UTC days, paired by fill seed k (day axes asserted identical); d-bar(t) = mean over k of d_k(t); estimate = mean over the judgment-window days of d-bar, reported in bps/day (x1e4). Moving-block bootstrap on the day axis exactly as bt_tables.mbb_indices (non-circular, block starts uniform on 0..n-b, ceil(n/b) blocks concatenated and truncated to n), B = 10,000, rng = numpy.random.default_rng([20260923, 1]); blocks 30 days (main) and 5 days (sensitivity), each drawn from a fresh generator with that seed. 97.5% two-sided interval (Bonferroni over the two seeds) = percentiles 1.25 / 98.75 of the draws; the 95% interval (2.5 / 97.5) is reported beside.

O8_criteria_as_computed.G2: number of {2023H2, 2024, 2025} with segment mean d-bar > 0 is >= 2 (segment means over that segment's full UTC days)
O8_criteria_as_computed.G3: min over the 3 segments of NEW path-mean Sharpe >= min over the 3 segments of OLD path-mean Sharpe - 0.10, AND NEW path-mean maxDD_5m over the judgment window >= OLD path-mean maxDD_5m - 0.02 (drawdowns are negative numbers)
O8_criteria_as_computed.G4: for each cost cell c in {fee_x1.25, slip_x1.5, fill_x0.9}: the G1 estimate computed from NEW_c vs OLD_c (both arms under the same cell, same seeds) has the same strict sign as the base-cell G1 estimate
O8_criteria_as_computed.G5: path mean over 32 seeds of the judgment-window count of section 4-2 day-stop flattens: NEW <= 1.25 x OLD
